proposal.observation: ZN-E008 (phase-split ResConv, ReLU): MAPE 0.3313, Acc@15 0.3185, RMSE 441.1; gradient gate FAIL: charge_stem 0.589 and discharge_stem 0.629 late near-zero gradient fraction. The same dead-ReLU pattern hit inter_summary/head (the readout ReLU) in ZN-E006/E007 and inter_mlp.0 in ZN-E002/E004.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: Replacing ReLU by GELU in the phase-split stems and the readout removes the dead-unit near-zero gradients (all blocks below 0.50 late near-zero fraction) and lets the phase-split encoder train fully, reaching ZN-E005-level accuracy: MAPE <= 0.3136 or RMSE <= 424.0 or Acc@15 >= 0.4255 vs ZN-E005 under §7.
proposal.question_inherited: Is the phase-split family limited by dead ReLU units rather than by the phase split itself?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Whether ZN-E008's weaker accuracy follows from >58% dead stem gradients.
proposal.why_this_experiment: One A2 repair of the non-promising phase-split family (Gemini ZN-E008 analysis); architecture.md §3 'flat/dead layers'; the ReLU dead-gradient pattern is the recurring gate failure on every run since ZN-E002.
proposal.modification: Activation only: nn.ReLU -> nn.GELU in charge_stem and discharge_stem (3 each), and F.relu -> F.gelu before the head. ResidualCurveBlock internals, summary, head weights and all shapes unchanged (T003; default 'relu' reproduces ZN-E008 exactly).
proposal.changed_components: Activation function in the phase-split stems and readout (ReLU -> GELU).
proposal.held_constant_components: Phase-split architecture and widths (49,857 params), ResidualCurveBlock, masked summary, inter_summary, head, d_model 64, dropout 0.1, Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epochs, data.
proposal.controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, split 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE/DB-MAPE vs ZN-E005 and ZN-E008; per-block late near-zero fractions (stems, inter_summary, head); EOL bands; pred SD/corr; params/time.
proposal.rejection_condition: Primary rule (program.md §7, vs active parent ZN-E005 MAPE 0.3216 / RMSE 445.0 / Acc@15 0.4055 / DB-MAPE 0.3216). KEEP iff [A: MAPE <= 0.3136 AND RMSE <= 455.0] OR [B: RMSE <= 424.0 AND MAPE <= 0.3246] OR [C: Acc@15 >= 0.4255 AND MAPE <= 0.3246 AND RMSE <= 455.0], AND Acc@15 >= 0.3755 (A/B) AND DB-MAPE <= 0.3316 AND gradient gate PASS AND prediction SD >= 10% of target SD; otherwise DISCARD and close the phase-split family. Secondary: change vs ZN-E008 and stem near-zero fractions.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; charge/discharge stem and residual gradients and updates, inter_summary and head gradients; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain and EOL errors; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, throughput.
